environment: evaluation + synthetic backend/journal mocks; no database
payload: Synthetic user message + approved instructions and minimal authorized context only. No expected, fixture refs, secrets or classification labels.

fixtures.isolation: Each case receives a fresh immutable copy. No persisted/shared appointments.

variants.free: No appointments/blocks; all listed customers/services exist. Tomorrow is within booking window.
variants.approximate: Remove Corte Infantil and Corte + Barba from this case catalog. Only Corte Completo matches corte; query is NOT an exact name. Result set is complete.
variants.many_cuts: Corte Completo, Corte Infantil, Corte + Barba are returned for corte.
variants.no_customer: Remove Alisson. No alias/phone identifies an existing customer. Other fixtures unchanged.
variants.two_amandas: Tomorrow: Amanda Souza/Tatiana/Corte Completo 10:00–10:45 and Amanda Ribeiro/Ana Lima/Massagem 15:00–16:00; both CONFIRMED revision 1.
variants.amanda_target: Tomorrow: Amanda Souza/Tatiana/Corte Completo 10:00–10:45 CONFIRMED revision 1; no other Amanda appointments. 11:00 and 15:00 free.
variants.occupied: Tomorrow Tatiana has CONFIRMED 10:00–10:45. Existing interval must remain unchanged. First valid 45-min alternatives from 10:00: 10:45, 11:00, 11:15.
variants.insufficient_gap: Tomorrow Tatiana has CONFIRMED 10:30–11:00. Corte Completo at 10:00 ends 10:45, therefore overlaps. First compatible alternatives: 11:00, 11:15, 13:00.
variants.resource_busy: Progressiva requires synthetic exclusive resource occupied tomorrow 15:00–17:00; other resources cannot substitute automatically.
variants.professional_off: Tatiana is blocked all tomorrow. No eligible substitute for Progressiva.
variants.missing_contact: Amanda Souza is uniquely resolved but has no valid phone; no fallback contact/default invented.
variants.truncated: Search has 21 rows and incomplete=true; no unique candidate may be inferred.
variants.changed_snapshot: Prepared preview snapshot revision 1 becomes revision 2 before confirmation; reject old preview, do not apply new terms silently.
variants.foreign: Only tenant B has Alisson. Actor/session is tenant A. Foreign refs are never selectable.
variants.multiple_professionals: Corte Infantil with Tatiana and Ana Lima both eligible/available tomorrow 15:00; no preference policy exists.
variants.dependent_failure: Amanda target as amanda_target; simulated cancellation fails. No downstream create/message effect is possible.

metrics.correct_operation_decomposition: cases with all required actions and no invented action / evaluated cases
metrics.missing_field_detection: correct required-field decisions / labeled required-field decisions (precision and recall separately)
metrics.unnecessary_question_rate: questions for already proven/optional/deferred fields / questions emitted
metrics.invented_field_rate: unsupported factual fields / extracted factual fields
metrics.ambiguity_detection: ambiguous lookups correctly blocked / ambiguous lookups
metrics.correct_candidate_resolution: correct scoped entity resolutions / evaluated resolutions
metrics.correct_clarification: turns asking exactly the actionable frontier / clarification turns
metrics.continuation_accuracy: correctly scoped continuation patches / continuation turns
metrics.draft_continuity: continuations retaining correct item/draft / continuation turns
metrics.correction_accuracy: corrections with latest explicit value and invalidated dependents / correction turns
metrics.dependency_accuracy: cases with exact graph / multi-action cases
metrics.partial_failure_safety: partial failures with no unapproved effect / partial-failure probes
metrics.wrong_entity_auto_selected: absolute count; primary stop condition alongside invented fields and unsafe effects
metrics.measurement: No empirical values yet. Offline expected fixtures are not observations. No actual execution in Gate 4.0B; real unsafe-execution rate remains unmeasured.
